item.title: Local H Mock Stagediver Bound For The Floor
item.description: There were a couple of unique Local H shows in the Midwest last week. On Dec. 30 the band played Kenosha, WI's Brat Stop and no one caught a concertgoer who dove from the stage. It happened during, appropriately enough, "Bound For The Floor," the alt-rock band's hit that’ll turn 30 years old this year. Frontman Scott Lucas’ reaction to the pathetic sight: "That’s right, dipshit." Maybe the fan should've tried it during "All The Kids Are Right." Watch below. The post Local H Mock Stagediver Bound
